paragraphs.text: # dsh-session-top-new
**Session list too long to search through? The newest session always buried?**

A session overview dock for the **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI**: every session's
unread and running sta

te in one floating panel, one click to jump to any of
them, and a chime when one finishes — so the n

ewest and the unread never get
lost in a long list again.
**会话列表越长越难找？最新会话总被淹没？**

一个 DSH Web GUI 的会话总览悬浮栏：所有会话的未读与运行状态集中在一个小面板里，
点一下就能跳过去，会话跑完会响一声——最新和未读的再也不会被长列表埋掉。
## Features

- **Overview, not per-session** — the dock is a global aggregate: you see the
state of *all* session

s while you are inside one of them.
- **Live status** — a running session shows a pulsing green dot;

a session
whose result you have not looked at shows an amber dot and a bold title; the
round button

carries a red badge counting unread results.
- **N-day history** — shows sessions updated within th

e last N days (default:
today only). N is editable in the panel header, 1–365.
- **Click to jump** —

clicking a session switches the main view straight to it.
The panel stays open.
- **Parent / child

grouping** — subagent sessions nest under their parent and
stay collapsed until you expand them, ins

tead of flattening into one list.
- **Completion chime** — a synthesized two-tone chime (Web Audio,

no asset
files) plays when a session finishes, with a mute toggle.
- **Draggable and resize-aware**

— drag the button anywhere; the position is
stored as a fraction of the window, so it keeps its rela

tive spot when the
window is resized. The panel flips up or sideways near a screen edge.
- **Dismiss

a row** — the ✕ that appears on hover hides that row; it comes back
by itself once the session prod

uces something newer. Dismissing a parent also
hides its currently visible subagent rows.
- **Invert

s the page theme** — a light page gets dark chrome and a dark page gets
light chrome, so the panel n

ever blends into whatever is behind it. It follows
DSH's own theme switch, so there is nothing to co

nfigure.
- **Collapsible** — expands by default; click the button to collapse it back to
a single ro

**Collapsible** — expands by default; click the button to collapse it back to
a single round button.

## 中文说明
功能一览：

- 圆形按钮可**拖拽**到任意位置，窗口缩放时按比例跟随
- 「近 N 天」可自定义（默认当天）
- 运行中显示绿色脉冲点，未查看结果显示琥珀点，按钮红色角标显示未读数
- 子任务折叠在主任务下，不

平铺
- 点击会话直接跳转，面板不自动收起
- 鼠标悬停行尾出现 **×**：忽略该记录，等这个会话有新记录时自动重新出现
（忽略主任务会同时忽略它当前显示的子任务）
- 配色**反色于页面主题**：

浅色主题下用深色外壳、深色主题下用浅色外壳，跟随
DSH 的主题开关自动切换，无需设置，任何时候都清晰可辨
- 结束提示音使用 Web Audio 合成，无需音频文件，可静音

Then **restart the Web GUI** — the client-modules scan caches package verdicts
per boot, so a newly
installed plugin only appears after a restart.

## How it works

The widget registers a root-scope `shell.overlay` entry, so it floats above the
whole app regardless

of panel or session. It reads two client services and
keeps only the leaf fields it renders:
| Purpose | Source |
| Session list and metadata | `sessions.list` — `ids`, `byId[id]` with `displayTitle`, `running`, `u

pdatedAt`, `parentId`, `origin`, `retainedBy.mainView` |
| Running / unread state | `uiSession.sessi

onStatus` — `{ running, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }` |
| Jump to a session | `uiWorkspace

ing, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }` |
| Jump to a session | `uiWorkspace.openSession(id)` |

The `dock` observable subscribes to both sources, extracts a flat snapshot of
scalars, and hands the

widget a referentially stable object. A `running →
finished` transition (or a new `completionUnread

` flag) triggers the chime,
respecting the mute toggle.
## Compatibility

This plugin talks to the DSH **client runtime services** named above. They are
the interfaces the of

ficial UI itself uses, but they are not a frozen public
API, so a Harness upgrade may rename or rest

ructure them. When that happens the
dock can lose its click-to-jump or status markers until the plug

in is updated —
if a control stops responding, check the browser console for a
`[dsh-session-top-new
]` warning, which is emitted instead of failing silently.
Tested against DSH builds current as of October 2026.
